detail: Refines warning 01KZ6VGPTY2APARVY53RFF5E3S. Per https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp.md: plugin-provided MCP configs "substitute ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} directly" (line ~110); ${VAR:-default} is documented general syntax (line ~450); unrecognized bare ${VAR} is left literal with a missing-variable warning in `claude mcp list` (line ~477). So the field blanking was two documented mechanisms composing badly, not an interpolator bug: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is not in the environment at expansion time, so ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-} legitimately expanded to its (empty) default. Practical rule unchanged: ONLY the bare ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} form in plugin/.mcp.json (and other plugin JSON). The test emulator in test/hooks/launch-server.test.ts implements this doc-consistent model.
summary: Doc-backed mechanism for ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-} blanking: plugin configs substitute the bare form directly (not an env var); :-forms hit general default expansion where the absent var yields ""
